sol_high.timing_definition: Elapsed monotonic milliseconds from request dispatch to first response text delta, first complete sentence-boundary heuristic, and response.completed. Synthetic fixed prompts only; no audio synthesis or playback.

asr_screen.initial_raw_pocket_issues: ASR flagged curly contractions (including Anna reassurance replaced by a different sentence) and 1:45 as 4.5; not a human listening judgement.
asr_screen.normalization: curly apostrophes to ASCII; only two known fixture times explicitly spoken; never infer AM/PM
asr_screen.remaining_mismatches: Three formatting/spelling differences only: omelet/omelette and October 7th / 2.30 / 1.45; numerical values correct in ASR output.

missing_measurements.endpointing_wait: 1200 ms design setting, not actual integrated measurement

cloud.qwen_official_demo: Two actual clips; hosted revision and latency unmeasured; shared ZeroGPU quota/queue not a qualified application backend
cloud.pocket_official_demo: Remote CPU demo exists; no supported free production endpoint qualified
cloud.additional_candidate: Azure Speech F0 en-US-JennyNeural: documented recurring 500000 neural characters/month, 20 requests/60 sec; no resource created, no paid tier enabled, not tested

verification.live_scope: actual fixed synthetic synthesis, public WSS browser render/cancellation, separate Sol-high text probe

limitations: Rendering means the main thread received an AudioWorklet message after nonzero output frames; not physical audibility.
Desktop browser was on the host PC using the actual public Cloudflare route; no separate phone/mobile network was tested.
ASR/Sol/TTS are not an integrated care conversation; do not sum independently measured stages and label it measured end-to-end latency.
Repeated samples are n=3 per short/long condition; no percentile, load capacity or reliability claims.
Pocket warmup/load and connection/audio unlock are excluded from warmed request latency and recorded separately.
Public streaming endpoint accepts fixed synthetic identifiers only; it does not authorize care data or arbitrary text.
Sol sentence-boundary heuristic may identify a greeting before a meaningful answer; it is not a full meaningful-turn measurement.
